tasks.title: Add TanStack Query dependency and root provider
tasks.dod: package.json lists @tanstack/react-query; the app renders under a QueryClientProvider nested inside ClerkProvider in the root layout with no runtime error.

tasks.title: Define the dashboard query with conservative, identity-scoped config
tasks.dod: a unit test asserts the query's options set staleTime/gcTime to Infinity, refetchOnWindowFocus/refetchOnReconnect to false, and retry to false; a unit test asserts the query key includes the signed-in Traveler's identity.

tasks.title: Migrate DashboardContainer to the query hook
tasks.dod: component tests confirm: a cache-hit revisit renders with no new fetch and no loading state (AC-01); a first load shows the loading indicator until the fetch resolves (AC-06); a confirmed invalid-session response redirects to sign-in and shows no dashboard data (AC-03), distinct from a connectivity/server failure.

tasks.title: Add the retry control to the error state
tasks.dod: component test confirms a non-session-invalid failure shows the recoverable error with one Button retry control, no automatic retry fires, and triggering it re-issues exactly one fetch.

tasks.title: Preserve the linked confirmation across a later fetch
tasks.dod: component test confirms that once the linked confirmation is shown, a later fetch (e.g. the AC-02 retry) whose response reads linked=false does not hide it, re-trigger it, or re-run the account-linking action.

tasks.title: Clear the identity-scoped cache on server-confirmed logout
tasks.dod: integration test confirms the dashboard query cache entry for the logged-out Traveler's identity is removed as soon as the logout response confirms the server revoked the session, independent of whether the client-side sign-out step succeeds or fails, and a subsequently-signed-in different Traveler's dashboard fetch never reads the prior entry.

tasks.title: Test DashboardContainer/DashboardScreen against AC-01/02/03/04/06
tasks.dod: DashboardContainer.test.tsx and DashboardScreen.test.tsx cover: dedup call-count pinning (AC-01), retry-control behavior with no auto-retry (AC-02), the invalid-session-vs-connectivity-error split (AC-03), confirmation persistence across a retry (AC-04), and the loading indicator on first load and on retry (AC-06); all pass.

tasks.title: Test dashboard-query cache config, identity scoping, and logout clear
tasks.dod: dashboard-query.test.ts covers the conservative option set, the identity-scoped key, the retention rule (no eviction before sign-out/page unload), and the logout-clear behavior (AC-05); all pass.
